items.text: In adults with epilepsy using self-management apps, is sustained engagement (weekly use for at least six months), compared with early disengagement, associated with better antiseizure medication adherence and fewer seizures?
items.population: Adults with epilepsy who installed a self-management app
items.intervention: Sustained engagement: weekly use for at least six months
items.outcome: Antiseizure medication adherence and seizure frequency

finer: Interesting and relevant to the clinic's decision; novelty uncertain; feasibility depends on how many studies report outcomes by engagement.
summary: One PICO question on engagement and outcomes.
